lines: Nigeria goes to the polls in January 2027.
Here is what you need to know about the general elections, in under three minutes.
There are two election days.
On Saturday, January sixteenth, Nigerians vote for the President and the National Assembly.
Three weeks later, on February sixth, they vote for governors and state Houses of Assembly.
These dates are earlier than first planned.
INEC originally fixed February twentieth for the presidential vote.
It revised the calendar after President Tinubu signed the Electoral Act 2026, in February 2026.
On day one, voters choose a President, all one hundred and nine Senators, and all three hundred and sixty members of the House of Representatives.
On day two, twenty-eight states elect a governor, and all thirty-six states elect their Houses of Assembly.
The other eight states hold governorship elections on their own, off-cycle calendar.
How does a candidate win the presidency?
They need the most votes nationwide.
And they need at least twenty-five percent of the vote in at least two-thirds of the states and the F.C.T.
If nobody clears that bar, a second round is held.
Eighteen candidates are on INEC's final presidential list.

In alphabetical order, they include Atiku Abubakar of the A.D.C., Donald Duke of the P.R.P., Seyi Makinde of the A.P.M., Peter Obi of the N.D.C., Sandy Onor of the P.D.P., and President Bola Tinubu of the A.P.C.
Two of the eighteen candidates are women.
On election day, accreditation and voting run from eight-thirty a.m. to two-thirty p.m.
Bring your Permanent Voter Card.
Your identity is checked on the BVAS machine.
Results from each polling unit can then be viewed on INEC's online results portal.
By the numbers: more than ninety-three million registered voters.
More than one hundred and seventy-six thousand polling units.
And twenty-two registered political parties.
So, find your polling unit. Collect your P.V.C.
And before you share a rumour about the election, check it against INEC's official channels.
Your vote. Your voice. January sixteenth, 2027.
